_meta.description: GET /api/vehicles (rest-api.md §7.0) carrying rideShareEnabled in all THREE of the states a consumer must tell apart (MYR-342, contracts 0.20.0). Lunar is PAUSED (explicit false) on a car that is otherwise perfectly healthy — online, parked, idle, not in service — which is the whole point of the field: the pause is owner intent, not vehicle state. Stumpy carries an explicit true. Boxy OMITS the key entirely, the shape a pre-0.20.0 server emits, and it MUST read as ENABLED: absence never means paused, and a consumer that failed closed on a missing key would withdraw a car nobody withdrew.
